finding_status.notes: nginx.local-test.conf now sets 'proxy_set_header Host localhost:8080' in place of 'Host $host', matching the Vite dev proxy's changeOrigin target so backend-generated absolute URLs (routers/files.py request.base_url.netloc, a2a/utils.py) resolve to the published backend port instead of this server's SPA catch-all. Verified three ways: the source change, the directive present at line 44 of the conf inside the built image, and a full sanity-ui run against that image (71 passed, 2 xpassed, 232.58s, exit 0). X-Forwarded-* was intentionally not added — the backend rate limiter keys on X-Forwarded-For and the dev proxy sends none, so adding it would have created a new divergence rather than closing one. The block's comment was extended to document the Host behavior.
